# glad (generated OpenGL loader)

These files are generated by [glad2](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad) and committed as they are.
Do not edit them by hand; regenerate them instead.

- Generator: glad2 2.0.8 (`pip install glad2==2.0.8`)
- API: OpenGL 4.6 core profile
- Extensions: `GL_ARB_bindless_texture`, `GL_ARB_gl_spirv`, `GL_ARB_indirect_parameters`,
  `GL_ARB_texture_filter_anisotropic`, `GL_ATI_meminfo`, `GL_EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic`,
  `GL_KHR_debug`, `GL_NVX_gpu_memory_info`

The extensions cover the fast paths the renderer picks at runtime (Section 4 of the plan): indirect
count draws and SPIR-V on drivers that only offer them as extensions, bindless textures, anisotropic
filtering, debug output, and video memory figures for the overlay.

## Regenerating

```
python -m glad --api "gl:core=4.6" --extensions "GL_ARB_bindless_texture,GL_ARB_indirect_parameters,GL_ARB_gl_spirv,GL_ARB_texture_filter_anisotropic,GL_EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic,GL_KHR_debug,GL_NVX_gpu_memory_info,GL_ATI_meminfo" --out-path engine/third_party/glad c
```

No loader option is used: the engine loads functions through SDL (`Window::glGetProcAddress`).
